steps.text: Act One
Spring
Use your spear to strike your shield.
Use your shield to block your spear.
Use your spear to strike your shield.
Use your shield to block... to block...
To block...
...oh my. This could go on forever, couldn't it?
What can we do? I have to think of something...
Use your spear to strike your shield...
Use your shield to block your spear...
It needs an 'and then' in there.
And then, and then... Ah, got it!
And then there is a massive explosion. That would do the trick, wouldn't it?
11:15 P.M. \ Clear
Lunar New Year's Eve, Lungmen, Forward Command Post
'District 14 reporting, all clear.'
'District 5 reporting, situation normal.'
'District 1 reporting, nothing out of the ordinary.'
'Green across the board. Good work, everyone. Stay on your toes.'
'Roger.'
'Understood.'

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yaaawn...

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You're on the night shift now. How's it going?

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Well, the migration is going according to plan. Movement speed normal. No anomalies.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: This is the only Originium reaction we need to check out. Take a look.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...'Suspected Originium explosive device activation'? What is it? Somebody shooting off fireworks in the park?

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Keep reading. There's a location.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Tung Fong Street, Number 122. It's a warehouse. Currently leased by Penguin... Oh, of course.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I can only hope we're in for another calm and peaceful year.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You said it. Let's just put in our hours and get home for chow.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That doesn't mean we get to relax. Chief Wei told us to stay frosty.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You know, I've lived in Lungmen my whole life, and every year people freak out...

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I've never seen the 'Nian' before. What is it?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I've never seen it either. And you asked me the same thing last year.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: The greenhorns are already convinced it's just an urban legend.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: If there was some kind of fire-breathing giant, we'd spot it before it got within thirty klicks of Lungmen and the defensive cannons would solve that problem pretty quick.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Must be some great big beast, highly territorial, but unlikely to ever attack a city.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That's what they say. But everybody's still on alert. I mean, it's on Chief Wei's own orders.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yeah, yeah. Save it. I've already written you clowns up for slurping down instant noodles in the control room. Not that I blame you. That's your New Year's banquet. Still waiting for your red envelopes full of money?

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Then Chief Wei's met the Nian?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You respect the chain of command, don't you?

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Of course! It's because of Chief Wei that I joined the force to begin with!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: It's just... to get all hands on deck, watching out for some giant nobody's seen for decades?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei's very thorough. She covers all her bases. You know this.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That's what they say...
S- sorry I'm late! I brought Originium test results!
Um? Where's... err... Chief Wei?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Well... Not here.
Wh- wha? But Superintendent Ch'en told me to check the control center...

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We're on the roof...

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Head down the stairs and make a left. That great big room with all the blinking lights? That's your control center.
Aaagh, I just ran up from there. Don't tell me I went the wrong way...
Sorry to bother you! I'll get out of your hair right away!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: What was that all about? Who was she?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Must be new. Looked like a techie.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Did you see how wired up she was? It's definitely her first New Year. Takes me back to my first time...
Phew, whew, sorry. Can you point me to the control center...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Snowsant? What are you doing back here?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Wha? Superintendent Ch'en, you beat me here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I think you got a little mixed up.
Ch'en, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.
The youngest Senior Superintendent in Lungmen history, and Snowsant's superior.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: S- s- s- s- s- sorry! I got lost!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Ummmmmmm... do you think maybe I'll need to be r-r-r-reprimanded for not delivering this extremely important report on time...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No, I don't think there's any need for that. You're new and I also bear some responsibility for not telling you the way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Sure... err... Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: It's already midnight, and there's still so many people around...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's like this every year. Just a precaution.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: ...a precaution? Oh, are you talking about the legendary Nian?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Were you in Columbia so long you never saw the L.G.D. face down the Lunar New Year?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: My grandma told me stories about the 'Nian' when I was little... But they were so scary I never thought they could be true...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Four-legged beasts, covered in flames from head to toe, awakened from their subterranean slumber by humans building their cities, they... No! No way they could be real!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stories, huh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lots of people think they're just stories. Whatever helps them sleep at night.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Too bad all the damage to our city throughout history isn't just stories. The names carved on the headstones aren't just stories.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's been quiet for many years. But we have to stay alert.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You've lived in Lungmen before, but you haven't been back for long. Now you need to brush up on everything you've missed.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: S-s-s-sorry! Everyone's working so hard, I guess I should probably...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Sigh*. Just calm down...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nobody in this building has ever met the Nian before.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We've got a lot of greenhorns who don't believe. Some of them even question the L.G.D.'s mission. It happens. I'm used to it.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Wow... Poor L.G.D....

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Go report to Chief Wei and then get some rest. I want another report first thing in the morning.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Ummmmmmm... Erm! Superintendent Ch'en! Could you tell me, um, what Chief Wei is like?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: When you told me I would meet her today... I um...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Before I answer you, I need you to gather up some confidence.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It was Chief Wei herself who personally sent the request for you to return from Columbia. You need to believe in yourself, and believe you can handle your mission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What I'm trying to say is: puff out that chest, girl!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: S- sorry...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Sigh*. That means you need to stop apologizing all the time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just like you're talking with me, you take all the information you've got, and calmly and coolly explain it to Chief Wei, in a nice, steady pace.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't overthink this.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Okay, I can do it, erm...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chief Wei.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: You've worked hard. Both of you.
Fumizuki, Chief Executive of Lungmen, Woman of Mystery.
...As yet unconfirmed rumors say that she has a dedicated husband managing internal affairs.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Now, not to denigrate your efforts, but it seems this report is a bit later than anticipated.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Oh, that would be because——

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry. We took some extra time to straighten out the report.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And there were some individuals consuming cup noodles in Sector 22's control center. I had to reprimand them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It was poor time management on my part. I take full responsibility, Chief Wei.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Yes, I understand.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Why don't you introduce this lovely young lady first?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is our senior engineer in charge of maintaining our outer perimeter installations. Codename Snowsant. I think you know her.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Th-th-th-th-th-this is our first time meeting! P-p-p-p-please call me Snowsant!
Snowsant, newly hired intern and head of Lungmen's Frontier Defense Engineering Department.
She holds the record for fastest promotion in history. And yet she has zero confidence in herself!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Um, but, I guess Superintendent Ch'en already introduced me...

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: This is not actually our first meeting, little Snowsant.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: And yet I see a whole new woman before me. Your time in Columbia has done much for you.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: You... you remember me?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: How could I forget? Your talent and character are known far and wide.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Not to mention your impressive record before you even left Lungmen.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Chief Wei has known about me for so long...? I... did I do something wrong?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: I make a point to know of our promising young people, that's all.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: I-I-I-I-I'm honored! But I never thought anyone would notice me, on account of I'm not so good with words...

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Unfortunately, I have no time for whitewashed plagiarism and self-serving rhetoric.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt, Chief Wei. We've received a docking request from a vessel belonging to one of our strategic partners.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ——Understood.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Snowsant, I will be brief. The L.G.D. is welcoming some guests shortly.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: This evening will be Lungmen's finest hour.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Ah, yes!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Wow, it's gotten so late...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We could have been earlier.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Ummm... Sorry. I'll look over the handbooks some more when I get home.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good thinking.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Don't worry! When you see me tomorrow, Superintendent Ch'en, I'll be able to draw a map of every level from memory!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Let's not get carried away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The point is, from now on you'll be reporting directly to Chief Wei. Don't get psyched out.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: R- right!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: But, um... Are you not going home, Superintendent Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I have other things to do. We're short handed, and I know a certain crowd that needs a direct approach.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not to mention... It hasn't been announced to the public yet, but the L.G.D. has some... leads.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Poor Superintendent Ch'en...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Never mind. I'm used to it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's your first New Year since you're back in Lungmen. Enjoy it.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Right! Thanks!
Lungmen Park

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Cheers.

steps.name: Crowd
steps.text: Cheers!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: To you, Madame Oni, and another great year with you!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: It's all thanks to Madame Oni that the gang did so well this past year!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Madame Oni! When are we going to Temple Street?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: ...Hey, no rush. We got lots of time——

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: But I'm still waiting on a guest. I know she's coming. I had a nasty vision. My eyelid twitched all morning.

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Huh? A guest? Who is it?

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: You! When did you get here?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Obstruction of justice, destruction of public property, trespassing, disturbing the peace, assault. You made a lot of noise last year, 'Madame Oni.'

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: They asked for it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you say so.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: You're a busy woman, Ch'en Sir. That must be why you're getting all mixed up and only just now remembering things from last year. Here, let's raise a glass to Ch'en Sir.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Save it. Let's skip the games. I know what you're about to do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But you're not going anywhere now.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: That doesn't make much sense, Ch'en Sir?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: We owned up to last year because we did wrong. But this time, we haven't done anything. You're still gonna lock us down?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't play dumb. Do I have to remind you what came of your strange little rituals last year?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. doesn't have the manpower to play around with you, so I'm nipping this in the bud.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: You think I'm playing around?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: *Deep sigh*. All right, for old time's sake, Ch'en Sir.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: You guys have been battening down the hatches on this year's Nian prep so hard, I was thinking Ursus already fired a shot across our bow.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: So we'll be good little boys and girls this time around. As long as you play by our rules.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I knew it would go down like this anyway.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: With one condition... If I win, you have to tell me what's got the L.G.D. on edge.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: 'This year's special circumstances...' You know what I mean, Ch'en Sir?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why would you want to know?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: There's always someone who wants to know.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All right. Fine. I'll play along.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: That's what I like to hear! Come on, let's get to drinking!

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: They're so rowdy over there.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: They're like this every year. Don't mind them. The rowdy types have rowdy rituals.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Back when we were on the force, we wouldn't let them get away with stuff like this.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Of course not. We even beat back the Nian.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Do you mean the time with the subsonic Originium slug?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: I mean the time with the underground legion.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: You weren't a cop yet then. I was.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Is that right? I can't remember.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Hey... did you just touch the board?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Certainly not. Have you ever known me to take back a move?

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: No, you never take back moves. You just wait until I'm not looking to swap around some pieces.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Why I never! And I resent the accusation! Ahahaha——

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Humm~♪ Hummm~♪

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: You're in a good mood.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: It's New Year's! Why wouldn't I be?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: I guess that's true...

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: But there's gotta be more to it?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Aren't you happy you passed the L.G.D. exam?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: I thought you wanted to join up just because of your dad, but it turns out you're really into it?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: There's that. It's always better to chase your own dreams than be at the mercy of others.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: So unlike you...

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: This is the way.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: But you're really so cheerful just for my sake?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: *Sigh*... do you have to say it like that...?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Heh. Thanks.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Cards on the table. That's the way to go.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: And here I thought you made a quick buck playing the forex market on Victoria's slide. I had you all wrong.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Or did your investments in Rim Billiton pay off? It was a mining thing... I think I remember the transfer process wasn't exactly above board.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Y- you know a lot about this...

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: But of course. We're friends, aren't we? Be-a-trix?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: I'm serious! You better not have been digging up dirt on me!

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Why I never.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: But maybe the L.G.D. would jump at the chance to get their hands on you. And wouldn't that be a great service?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Nooo way.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Anyway. There is one other bit of good news I won't keep from you.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Oh yeah. You're happy that we're out here having a nice stroll, that there's a party, and that all she can do is stare at L.G.D. data and maybe slip out on patrol for some fresh air.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: You know all that too?!

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Woman's intuition. How else do you think I passed that exam without studying?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Wha, no way! You didn't like bribe the L.G.D. or pull some other shady move...?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Ooh?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Wow, a firecracker! Now that's the sound of New Year's.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Huh? What's with you? Why'd you... Oh.

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Are you still afraid of firecrackers at your age?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: No. It just makes me uncomfortable that someone would use an uncontrollable explosive like that for such a frivolous purpose.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Explosive? A firecracker?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Yes. Firecrackers are an Originium explosive device, are they not?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Isn't that kind of blowing things out of proportion?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: ——Nonsense.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: ...Are you sure?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Well, I'd like to relive my childhood for a bit, so why don't we go buy a couple bundles to play with——

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Oh yes, I just remembered, there's a report on the investigation into you sitting in a certain drawer...

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: ...W- we'd better get along to that party.
Attention all units: a vessel is mooring. Attention all units: a vessel is mooring.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we've arrived.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is this your first time seeing Lungmen at New Year's?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's easy to get distracted by the festive atmosphere. But don't forget we have a job to do.

options: To 'ring in the New Year,' right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The 'Nian' is a legend... or so they say.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the records show that it is a real, if anomalous phenomenon.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Around the turn of each year, Lungmen, actually all of Yan, and even the parts of Ursus that wander nearby, get attacked.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The documented records of damage to each city don't match up very well, and the earlier legends are pretty murky.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some speak of giant, man-eating monsters. Some tell of a strange army. And still others speak of a group of mysterious casters.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's even a conspiracy theory floating around that some organized crime syndicate or other shadowy group fabricated the whole 'Nian' thing to cover up their activities...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Speaking of, weren't you listening in the meeting, Doctor?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Welcome to Lungmen, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei is waiting at the L.G.D. Please come with me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The point is, we'll go see Chief Wei first. She'll explain the important details.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Say... Doctor, have you seen Lava?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: H- how many bottles is this?

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Madame Oni, let's not..

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: The number!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Seventeen!

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Ugh... Since when... can you drink like this?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The L.G.D. has the occasional... get-together.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: What ngaang gaau 'get-togethers' are you talking about... bullshit... ugh...

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Gah, it's so hot! Hey, get some ice water, or beer or whatever!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: I think you've had enough, Madame Oni...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Take care of her, and don't go anywhere.

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: *Sigh*, come on, Madame, have some water.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: *GULP* *GULP* Ahh!

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Hey, Ch'en... Next time you wanna pay a visit... *hiccup* You don't have to come up with some... crazy excuse, you know?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We live in different worlds.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Now, since you admit defeat, I'll... nnng...

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Um...? Ch'en Sir, you're looking a little wobbly there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...You guys better get ready. If Chief Wei is right, then all of Lumgen is gonna hafta bland tofether...

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Ch'en Sir, are you really okay?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: *Deep breath* Pfft——

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When she wakes up, you tell her, the L.G.D. got a lead on the 'Nian.'

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: A lead? Like a giant footprint or something?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Crazy huge craters, melted buildings, massive scorch marks.

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Woah... I heard the Nian was actually a huge Originium slug thousands of miles long... is that true?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Our scouts couldn't find anything that looked like casting, but those marks definitely weren't there long.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Point is, if there's really something out there...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You guys gotta pitch in.

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: Why do we gotta help out the fuzz?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Because you can fight.

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: ...Hey now, I like the sound of that. Ch'en Sir ain't all bad!

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Don't you think it's really hot out today?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Early spring.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: It's midnight. This is an early spring?

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Whatever. Did that Lung get back to you yet?

steps.name: Honor Student
steps.text: Not yet. This isn't really what the L.G.D. messaging system is for.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Standard duty is off today, right? And it's my private channel anyway.

steps.name: Rich Girl
steps.text: Heh heh. She's probably so pissed off she's moping around the alleyways cursing herself.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: ...Wei, is that a fire?

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: What are you on about?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: It's just, why is it heating up even after the sun's gone down?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: To tell the truth, I have a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: It must be hard being apart from your beloved daughter. A man of your age, you've spoiled her rotten.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Like you would know.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Give it up. Don't change the subject. You think I'm going to let you cheat again?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: ...Hrm.

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Shift's up.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Is your report ready?

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: It's been ready. If you get here first tomorrow, do me a favor and get me a coffee.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Honestly...

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Oh, this is for you, to pass the time.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...'Tales of the Nian: A Compilation of Catastrophes from Several Countries'?

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Nah, what's the point. The Nian is some kind of mythological construct. How do people still believe in monsters and stuff?
What the hell is wrong with people these days? It's only been a few years and everything's totally different.
Aaahh, let's see here. Guh, I can't make sense of any of this new crap.
——Re... u... nion?
Hmm... Hmm...?
Come on? This is all we got?
Then I'll just have to use my imagination... Or not. What if they can't handle it...
Anyway, I'll figure it out.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Nnng... Mmf...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: That should be good? Let's start it up and see...

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: ——*Electrical hum*——

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: System activated.

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: Experiment log activated. Voice print recognized. Operator: Snowsant.

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: Current room temperature: 14℃. Analysis: room temperature abnormal.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: It worked...! Whew, using all that electricity paid off... Wait, abnormal?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Hm... There was a calibration log around here somewhere... where was that?

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: Number of calibration logs: 1.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: This one?

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: Room temperature analysis: significantly higher than regional average temperatures for this date. Presumed to be due to experimentation. No heat source found. No Originium reaction found. Added to log.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Hmm... The Originium detection function was a later addition. And it seems pretty sensitive...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Let's extend the range a bit.

steps.name: Laboratory Climate Control System
steps.text: Range extension failed. Cause: large amount of unresponsive objects in range. Presumed system failure. Troubleshooting in progress.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Let's see... The Originium reaction detector function uses feedback ripples from Originium reactions, so if an object isn't responding, that means it's undetectable to Originium Arts——

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: It's insulated from Originium reactions? A material totally resistant to Originium...?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: ...That's impossible!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Ugh... So it's actually malfunctioning... Wahh... the power bill...

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: And that is the scope of the task.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Rhodes Island has a history of excellence in dealing with such issues, and I look forward to our cooperation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you, Chief Wei.
Amiya, the leader of Rhodes Island. She may be young, but she is well regarded.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Doctor! Have you found Lava yet? Still?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahem. Chief Wei, um...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can we register the operators that will be working in Lungmen without them being physically present?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Do you speak of Miss Lava?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Miss Lava is an expert in Catastrophes, especially those of the distant past. It is thanks to her that we put our trust in Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Of course, we understand that Rhodes Island has many outstanding operators. But Miss Lava's familiarity with the Nian——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei! Forgive the interruption! It's an emergency.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: There are unidentified personnel in the city center.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...They have Reunion icons.
These marks...
They show they've already entered the city.
But it should be only a few of them. And among those, only one matches the records.
...Never mind.
No matter who they are, I will put a stop to them.
Never again.
